en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Ali Bin Al Rayyan, from Qasim Al Sayqal who said,

‘I did not see anyone who was more intense in strictness regarding the shade than Abu Ja’farasws. Heasws used to order with the dome of the tent and the two curtains (to be removed) when heasws wore Ihraam’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Rayyan from al-Qasim al-Sayqal who has said the following: “
I did not see anyone more strict about shadow in the state of Ihram than abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, who would command to remove the dome (tent) and its poles when he assumed the state of Ihram.’”
